native_code: QGfit 1.0.0 (github.com/qian-yang/QGfit, commit 3aed692); vendored copy patched for the LSQ-only UnboundLocalError (fitter.run_fit_conti, line.run_fit_line_one) and the missing-MCMC-block KeyError in prop.cal_prop

config_effective.line_mcmc_note: 50x300 line-MCMC pilot rejected: per-complex tau=20-42 steps, N_tau=5-11, and redchi_mcmc ~6e10 versus LSQ chi2_nu=11.5; LSQ covariance retained.

units.qgfit_line_flux: integral over rest-frame wavelength, 1e-17 erg s-1 cm-2
units.qgfit_model_csv: rest-frame f_lambda (observed * (1+z)^3); do not compare directly with observed-frame continuum columns from sibling tools

mcmc.note: continuum emcee chain; converged when N_tau >= 50, 0.05 <= acceptance <= 0.70 and the median posterior width is 0.5-2.0 times stderr_lsq/sqrt(redchi)

continuum.mcmc_fix_host_note: The BC03 host block is fixed at the LSQ solution because it is an unconstrained flat ridge for this QSO; the continuum MCMC is therefore a conditional posterior. The line fit and LSQ line errors are unchanged.

scope.note: QGfit is run on the observed SDSS spectrum without Galactic dereddening; the sibling tools also use the observed SDSS spectrum with EBV=0.  The H-beta total is the sum of the QGfit broad+narrow components; QGfit's BIC test can remove a narrow component when it is not required.  The native QGfit narrow-line profile is hard capped at FWHM=1200 km/s, so a broad [O III] wing can only be represented with an expanded line template.
